snippet.title: Claim the Forest | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #ClaimTheForest

🐺 Claim the Forest Launch Trailer 🐺
🌲 Available for Nintendo Switch, Playstation 4, Playstation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Microsoft Store!

In Claim the Forest, you enter a magical clearing where two unusual clans compete for territory: brave wolves and calm capybaras. Your challenge is to organize the pieces of these animals, along with logs, stones, and bushes, to fill the board without letting rivalry disturb the harmony.

KEY FEATURES
🐺 Two rival clans: Balance wolves and capybaras without clashes;
🐺 Earn stars with special challenges and restrictions;
🐺 30 levels ranging from cozy tutorials to challenging puzzles;

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
🌲 Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/claim-the-forest-switch/
🌲 Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016440
🌲 Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/claim-the-forest/9NG25DZ2T2ZV
🌲 Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/claim-the-forest-xbox-one/9nm39twltpcj
🌲 Microsoft Store: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/p/claim-the-forest-windows/9pg10qdbncd3
